mapper.select: SELECT id::text AS id, path, is_dir, size_bytes, revision, content_md5, content_sha256 FROM files WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND path = #{path, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND is_dir = false

SELECT id::text AS id, path, is_dir, size_bytes, revision, content_md5, content_sha256 FROM files WHERE user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND is_dir = false AND (#{prefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL OR path = #{prefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR path LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '/%')) ORDER BY path ASC

INSERT INTO documents(file_id, source_revision, extractor_version, content) SELECT f.id, #{sourceRevision}, #{extractorVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} FROM files f WHERE f.id = CAST(#{fileId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) ON CONFLICT (file_id, source_revision, extractor_version) DO UPDATE SET content = EXCLUDED.content, updated_at = now() RETURNING id::text AS id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM document_chunks WHERE document_id = CAST(#{documentId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)

DELETE FROM documents d USING files f WHERE d.file_id = f.id AND f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND d.file_id = CAST(#{fileId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND (d.source_revision <> #{sourceRevision} OR d.extractor_version <> #{extractorVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_chunks(document_id, chunk_index, source_revision, chunk_version, content) VALUES (CAST(#{documentId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid), #{chunkIndex}, #{sourceRevision}, #{chunkVersion, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{content, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR}) ON CONFLICT (document_id, chunk_index, chunk_version) DO UPDATE SET source_revision = EXCLUDED.source_revision, content = EXCLUDED.content, embedding = NULL, embedding_fingerprint = NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM documents d USING files f WHERE d.file_id = f.id AND f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND d.source_revision <> f.revision
mapper.update: UPDATE document_chunks c SET embedding = CAST(#{vector, jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} AS vector), embedding_fingerprint = #{fingerprint, jdbcType=VARCHAR} FROM documents d JOIN files f ON f.id = d.file_id WHERE c.id = CAST(#{chunkId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid) AND c.document_id = d.id AND d.source_revision = f.revision AND c.source_revision = d.source_revision AND f.user_id = CAST(#{userId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AS uuid)
